articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bittensor (TAO) rises 1.7%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Ripple (XRP) gained 1.6%, joining Bittensor (TAO) as a top performer.

articles.title: XRP edges higher while bitcoin, ether and dogecoin slip, keeping focus on $1.49 breakout zone
articles.snippet: XRP outperformed major tokens during a volatile session, with a late volume burst pushing price back toward resistance that has capped rallies for weeks.

articles.title: Tether’s T3 Crime Unit says it has frozen $450M in suspected illicit crypto
articles.snippet: T3 Financial Crime Unit says it has frozen over $450 million tied to suspected illicit activity as stablecoin compliance pressures intensify.

articles.title: Bank of England reconsiders strict stablecoin regime
articles.snippet: BoE weighs easing UK stablecoin caps and reserve demands after industry backlash, in a move that could decide whether GBP tokens can compete with dollar‑pegged rivals.

articles.title: Bank of England Softens ‘Overly Conservative’ Stablecoin Plans Amid Industry Pressure
articles.snippet: BoE officials are reportedly reviewing caps and reserve rules as the UK tries to keep stablecoin issuers onshore.
